basics.name: Antonio De Caro
basics.label: PhD Candidate
basics.summary: I am a PhD student in Computer Science at the University of Salerno, specializing in Graph Analytics on GPUs and heterogeneous programming using SYCL. Moreover, my research focuses on optimizing performance and energy efficiency through GPU frequency scaling. Originally from Mercato San Severino, I hold a BSc in Computer Science and an MSc in Cloud Computing, which included an Erasmus thesis in Sweden. Passionate about technology, science, and continuous learning, I also enjoy music, gaming, and exploring creative ways to complement my analytical mindset.
